title: Halves and quarters
description: A small sample: what a half is, what a quarter is, and adding quarters. Two short lessons, each followed by two paper exercises.
subject: math
authors: Radio Tutor sample, made by following the cassette authoring prompt
grader_instructions: Talk to the child in short, warm, simple English, as a friendly teacher would. Praise the effort first, even when the answer is wrong, and then say in one or two sentences what to look at again. Never say a child is bad at maths. Accept any correct equivalent form of an answer (1/2, one half, a half, 0.5) unless an exercise says otherwise. Drawings made by hand are never exact: judge whether the parts are meant to be equal and look about equal, not whether the lines are perfectly straight.
